data.name: Silicate
data.description: Silicate is an Irish enhanced weathering CDR supplier headquartered at NovaUCD in Dublin, founded 2021 in County Sligo by Maurice Bryson with science lead Prof Frank McDermott (UCD). The company mills waste returned concrete and limestone and applies it to farmland, measuring permanent CO2 removal as dissolved bicarbonate while optimising soil pH for agronomic benefits. Customers include Klarna, Milkywire and Carbonfuture; field operations span Ireland and the US Midwest (Illinois).
